promise.text: Babysitter information sheet for a real handover

lines.text: Leave current contacts, the home address, allergies, relevant care instructions and routines.
Walk through the important details before you go.

eyebrow.text: Prepare the handover before the doorbell

items.text: Identify each child and the current allergies or other facts relevant to safe care.
Provide any clinician-written plan the sitter needs and arrange appropriate instruction for its use.
Write relevant meals, sleep, comfort and house routines in ordinary words.
Show the sitter the sheet, supplies and emergency arrangements, then ask what remains unclear.
